reasoning_summary: PCA shows ~16° rotation (MEDIUM confidence due to partial axis degeneracy) and the identity-init 5-iteration local ICP probe achieved zero fitness, meaning correspondences at base scale × 0.5 could not be established. This is the textbook case for a RANSAC-based global alignment followed by local ICP refinement. Moderate scale factors: global_corr_scale=5.0 (mid-range, accommodates rotation-induced displacements) and icp_max_corr_scale=2.0 (lenient enough for residual misalignment after global registration, but not so wide as to admit spurious correspondences).
